name: Emerald 3D Voxel Mod
description: Pokemon Emerald as a 3D voxel world: free camera, Pokemon in the overworld, 3D battles with Stadium 2 and Colosseum models.

optional_imports.name: Pokemon Stadium 2 (USA or Europe) ROM
optional_imports.description: Source ROM for the 3D Pokemon models (#1-251). .z64, .v64 and .n64 files are accepted and normalized by the engine.
